backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing a bootcamp waitlist with email normalization, duplicate checks, and read access to all entries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping bootcamp features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lookup file containing prewritten one-line summaries for all major frontend components and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme definitions with extensive OKLCH color variables and light/dark mode settings.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting metadata, favicon, fonts, and root mount for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component assembling all landing page sections and wiring scroll-to-waitlist behavior.
frontend/src/components/chatbot/chatbotS: Defines message and intent types and provides intent-matching logic to return canned responses and trigger optional actions.
frontend/src/components/chatbot/ChatbotW: Implements a toggleable chat widget UI that manages user/assistant messages, sends input to an intent matcher, and displays responses with auto-scrolling.
frontend/src/components/countdown/Countd: Renders a section with title text and a countdown timer to the February 14, 2026 bootcamp start date.
Uses a countdown hook to display remaining time or an expiration message in a styled grid layout.
frontend/src/components/faq/FaqAccordion: Provides an accordion UI for frequently asked questions with toggleable answers.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer showing logo, quick links, bootcamp details, and attribution with a decorative heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with logo, desktop/mobile navigation, and a waitlist CTA using smooth scrolling.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with background image, headline, CTAs, and bootcamp stats displayed in a 3‑column grid.
frontend/src/components/preview/Interact: Displays an interactive weekly course preview where users select a week to view a sample lesson.
frontend/src/components/syllabus/Syllabu: Shows a four‑week curriculum with icons and topic lists for each week in a styled grid layout.
frontend/src/components/waitlist/Waitlis: React form component that collects name and email, submits to the waitlist via a mutation, and shows success or error states.
Section wrapper that displays a header and renders the waitlist form with styling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: Hook that calculates and updates remaining time until a target date, returning days, hours, minutes, seconds, and expiration state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, login flow, stored identities, and related status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a waitlist mutation that calls the backend actor to add an entry and invalidates waitlist queries on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables defining the site's color palette, themes, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the main app.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing features, requirements, color palette, and current landing page build state.
